query:
RETURN $left AS contribution
UNION ALL
RETURN $right AS contribution
NEXT
RETURN SUM(contribution) AS total;
notes: Database procedure body; caller supplies non-null INT64 parameters $left and $right. UNION ALL preserves both equal-valued contributions; NEXT supplies the merged rows to SUM. References: SKILL.md; references/documented-syntax.md (composite query, Database statement block); references/documented-functions.md (sum, Database); references/procedure-language.md (procedure body and NEXT); references/checklist.md; references/identifiers.md. The bundled quote-identifiers helper confirms contribution and total are ordinary identifiers. No database execution performed.
